text:
sylvie_oncall: PagerDuty alert — Stargaze Retail (tenant: stargaze-prod) experiencing p95/p99 latency spikes in ap-southeast-1 on Dedicated pool A. Alert threshold breached 3x.
opsbot: Incident created INC-2026-0421. Runbook: dedicated-pool-latency. Paging on-call.
pagerduty: Paging @sylvie_oncall, @mike_sre (primary), escalation in 7m.
sylvie_oncall: I'm on. Joining call, gathering impact. jess_cs can you confirm customer-facing symptom?
jess_cs: Customer reports slow checkout completions (~10s -> 60s) and some 502s. Tier-1 is escalating for stargaze-prod orders.
mike_sre: Looking at infra metrics — GPU pool CPU steady, but request queueing metric queue_depth spiking and per-tenant qps for stargaze up 8x.
anya_eng: Model variant r2048-q8 run on same pool. We saw token-timeouts and KV-cache misses increasing. Possibly hot-tenant causing head-of-line.
sylvie_oncall: Initial mitigation plan: 1) isolate tenant to dedicated burst pool if possible 2) enable tenant-level rate caps 3) failover to ap-southeast-2 warm-spare region for routing 4) if needed, serve quantized fallback model r2048-q4.
mike_sre: Can we do a soft isolation first? Move stargaze-prod to tenant_isolation profile -> throttled concurrency 4, keep burst capacity disabled until we confirm.
anya_eng: Agreed. Doing a graceful drain from current slots and reassigning. Watch KV cache warmup impact.
sylvie_oncall: @deploy-bot kick isolation job.
deploy-bot: Running job isolation/tenant-move-stargaze -> target: dedicated-burst-pool-B (ap-southeast-1). Job id: j-8f2.
opsbot: Note: moving a tenant will cause short-lived 502s for sessions that hit evicted workers. Follow runbook section "tenant-move-graceful".
mike_sre: I see move started. Queue depth for other tenants unchanged. stargaze queue_depth dropping from 420 -> 60. Nice.
jess_cs: Sharing this with customer: "We are isolating your traffic to a dedicated slice and routing to a backup region while we stabilize. Expect degraded throughput for ~5-10m." OK?\ess: typo
jess_cs: sorry typo above — meant OK to send?
sylvie_oncall: Yes send. Keep customers updated every 5m. :thumbsup:
anya_eng: After isolation we should enable model-fallback for stargaze only: route to r2048-q4 (validated quality baseline) to reduce token compute. I can flip the policy now.
mike_sre: Do it. Patch:
```
PATCH /routing/tenants/stargaze-prod
{ "fallback_model": "r2048-q4", "concurrency_limit": 4 }
```
anya_eng: Pushed patch, rolling now.
opsbot: Routing change applied. 100% of stargaze-prod now has fallback model for new sessions.
mike_sre: Observability: p95 dropped from 4.2s -> 1.1s for new requests. p99 still at ~3.8s for in-flight requests.
sylvie_oncall: Good progress. Next: validate no SLO breach on other tenants and confirm KV-cache warmup completes. Mike, monitor error budget burn.
mike_sre: Error rate for stargaze 502s down 85%. Other tenants stable.
jess_cs: Customer acked update and asked for ETA to full recovery. Suggested message: "We expect stabilization within 15 minutes; we'll follow up when fully restored"
sylvie_oncall: Send that. Also record action items: - follow up with infra to size pool and consider temporary burst. - schedule postmortem with stargaze PK.
opsbot: Incident INC-2026-0421: status=mitigated, notes="tenant isolated + model fallback applied; monitoring."
deploy-bot: Completed isolation job j-8f2. No rollback needed.
sylvie_oncall: Handing off to mike_sre for 1hr watch. I'll update the incident and create a follow-up ticket for cost analysis.
mike_sre: Taking watch. Will escalate back if p99 > 5s or error > 2%.
jess_cs: I'll keep customer looped. Thanks team. :pray:
opsbot: Reminder: create postmortem within 48h.
sylvie_oncall: Closing slack thread, leaving incident open for watch.
